title.pt-BR: Primeira batida cardíaca - Desperta

1.summary:
Detective Re-l Mayer can`t help but feel that something strange is brewing in Romdo City. When she`s attacked late at night by a terrifying creature, her suspicions prove valid.
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: Confession of a Fellow Citizen: Confession
title.pt-BR: Confissões de um cidadão ideal - Confissões

2.overview: Re-l struggles to convince her peers of her encounters with the monsters, which she learns are called Proxy. She is removed from the investigation and finds that Iggy has had his memories of recent events erased. Meanwhile, Vincent finds himself on the run from a proxy and then the city's authorities.
2.summary:
Re-l`s account of her encounter with the mysterious phantom falls on disbelieving ears. If the truth is to be exposed, she will have to find it herself.
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Se atirando no vazio - Cidade labirinto

3.overview: Romdo is no longer a safe haven for Vincent. He is trying to avoid capture by the authorities. As he flees he comes across the infected AutoReiv Pino. Pino then shows him the way to escape from Romdo to the outside world. Re-l struggles to contact Vincent and uncover the true nature of his involvement with the Proxy.
3.summary:
Re-l discovers a tangent point between a male immigrant under her probationary supervision and the phantom.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 未来詠み, 未来黄泉 futu-risk
title.en: Signs of Future, Hades of Future: Futu-Risk
title.fr: Signes du futur, Hades du futur
title.it: Visione futura. l`ade del futuro - futu-risk
title.pt-BR: Oráculo do futuro, submundo do futuro - Futu-risco

4.overview: Vincent and Pino are taken in by a small commune, the inhabitants of which make a living off the refuse dumped from the Dome. Meanwhile, Raul plans his move to locate and capture Vincent.
4.summary:
Re-l finds a clue which she uses to follow Vincent Law`s footprints. Meanwhile, Vincent and Pino begin to explore the outside world?
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Re-convocação - O Caso

5.overview: Re-l braves the outside world in order to bring Vincent back to Romdo. While there, Raul commences his plan to capture Vincent by attacking the Commune with patrol drones. Re-l's environmental suit is damaged and Vincent is injured in the attack. Re-l suspicions are confirmed that there is a link between Vincent and the Proxies.
5.summary:
Re-l leaves Romdo for the first time. After she recovers from the initial shock, a colony appears made of rubble created from cast off scraps of Romdo. It was a place called the "Commune" where those who ran away from the dome gathered and lived.
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Retorno - Volta ao domo

6.overview: Re-l's life becomes endangered when she falls ill after exposure to the harsh environment. Hoody hatches a cunning plan to trick Raul and return to Romdo. Quinn leads a group on an escape from the Commune using the Rabbit.
6.summary:
Re-l catches an infectious disease while trying to rescue Vincent. The Commune`s residents tell him that they will give him a vaccine to treat the infection if he obeys a certain condition.
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: RE-L124C41+ - A verdadeira para buscar o escolhido

7.overview: Re-l recovers from her illness. Daedalus shows her the disturbing mechanisms responsible for the Dome's continued survival. Vincent makes his way home, slowly losing his companions along the way, ending up alone with Pino. A group of infected AutoReivs is unleashed on Re-l, Iggy, and Daedalus. The episode ends with Daedalus filling out Re-l's death certificate.
7.summary:
Vincent, Pino and the surviving members of the commune escape from the shadows of Romdo. They push ahead down a single road to Vincent`s hometown, Mosko Dome. However, the harsh environment bears down on Vincent and his group.
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Sinal luminoso - Raio de luz

8.overview: Vincent and Pino stumbles onto war-torn Halos, where they are caught in a war between the dome's human inhabitants and its autonomous AutoReivs.
8.summary:
The journey to Mosko has begun. Vincent and Pino single-mindedly forge ahead the frozen land where nothing can be seen. Armed helicopters and combat jeeps suddenly appear. They have entered a combat zone where those who fight against AutoReivs live.
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Fragmento brilhante - A partilha dos anjos

9.overview: Vincent is introduced to a man named Hauer, and learns some truths about Halos and Proxies, discovering a horrific revelation.
9.summary:
Vincent finds himself in an unfamiliar room. In front of the stunned Vincent appears Kazkis Hauer, a mysterious individual who is a lover of wine. What is the true identity of this beautiful man who invites Vincent?
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Existência - Citotropismo

10.overview: Disturbed by recent events, Raul questions the future of Romdo. Meanwhile, Re-l and Iggy explore a strange antiquated dome inhabited only by primitive AutoReivs.
10.summary:
Although referred to as "paradise" by it`s citizens, the administrative control system of Romdo is starting to fray. Realizing this, Raul and Daedalus insist on improving the system.
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Dentro da escuridão branca - Anamnese

11.overview: Vincent finds a strange book store and an even stranger old man, where he discovers more about his true nature. Re-l and Iggy catch up on the Centzon (the Rabbit, the flying ship that Vincent travels by).
11.summary:
Vincent gets lost in thick fog and arrives at a used-book store. He enters the store to ask for directions. The creepy owner of the store recommends a certain book to him. Vincent`s name was engraved in the title of that book?
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Se você sorrir - Esconderijo

12.overview: The group is confronted by a vagrant Proxy and its companion AutoReiv, and Re-l puts her new weapon to use.
12.summary:
Vincent and Pino take a breather inside a deep forest. Pino sets out to explore their new surroundings and comes upon a girl picking flowers. But as soon as the girl realizes that Pino was there, she disappears into the forest. A fated reunion occurs.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 構想の死角 wrong way home
title.en: Conceptual Blind Spot: Wrong Way Home
title.it: Punti morti concettuali - wrong way home
title.pt-BR: A lacuna no plano - Caminho errado para casa
title.x-jat: Kousou no Shikoku: Wrong Way Home

13.overview: An infected Iggy becomes enraged and kidnaps Re-l, setting out to kill Vincent. Re-l is again confronted by the homeless AutoReiv.
13.summary:
Chasing after the flower girl, Pino enters a cave where, in front of her eyes, appear the girl and a mysterious giant sitting beside her. Around that time, a shadow approaches behind Vincent, who was searching for Pino.
Source: crunchyroll

title.it: Qualcuno che assomilglia a te - ophelia
title.pt-BR: Alguém que se parece com você - Ophelia

14.overview: While resting in a long-abandoned dome, strange occurrences take place and the trio's lives are endangered.
14.summary:
Vincent, Re-l and Pino stop at a deserted dome to replenish their supplies. Re-l discovers a beautiful verdant garden and proceeds to walk into it, totally unaware of the eyes staring at her.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 生悪夢のクイズSHOW! WHO WANTS TO BE IN JEOPARDY!
title.en: Nightmare Quiz Show! Who Wants to Be in Jeopardy!
title.it: Who wants to be in Jeopardy!
title.ru: Адская викторина - Кто хочет стать миллионером?
title.pt-BR: O quiz show pesadelo - Ninguém quer estar em sabatina
title.x-jat: Ki Akumu no Quiz Show! Who Wants to Be in Jeopardy!

15.overview: Finding himself in a bizarre live game show, Vincent's trivia knowledge is put to the test as he battles for his life.
15.summary:
The reality gameshow craze reaches out to touch our world weary travellers. Vincent goes head to head in a fatal face off with a host who knows much more than he should.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: デッドカーム busy doing nothing
title.pt-BR: Calma morta - Ocupado fazendo nada

16.overview: When winds die out, the trio are stranded aboard the Centzon and Re-l finds herself struggling to hold on to her sanity.
16.summary:
The travelers are at a standstill. Without any way to get moving, they spend the days in anguish, just hoping for the wind to start blowing. An incident occurs that serves to permanently differentiate Re-l from a Good Citizen?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 終わらない戦い terra incognita
title.pt-BR: Luta sem fim - Terra incógnita

17.overview: Romdo is on high alert as they search for the fugitive Raul, who plans to activate a deadly weapon. Meanwhile, the trio discover strange humanoids living inside a toxic cave system.
17.summary:
The journey to Mosko is almost at its end. Along the way, Pino suddenly disappears. Vince and Re-l search for her and discover a cave leading underground. There they discover a truth that they could never begin to imagine?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 終着の調べ life after god
title.en: Sign of the End: Life After God
title.ru: Осмотр места прибытия - Жизнь после бога
title.pt-BR: Inspecionando o destino final - Vida após deus
title.x-jat: Shuuchaku no Shirabe: Life After God

18.overview: The trio reach the devastated Mosko, Vincent's home city, and find that the truths lead back to Romdo.
18.summary:
Finally, Vincent and his group arrive at the Mosko Dome. As Vince walks all over the desolate dome city, he is unable to remember anything from his past.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 少女スマイル eternal smile
title.en: The Girl with a Smile: Eternal Smile
title.pt-BR: Sorriso eterno - A garota do sorriso

19.overview: Pino explores the mysterious Smile Land with the NaKaMa, and confronts the Creator of the city.
19.summary:
A thrilling and enjoyable story about the AutoReiv, Pino, and her friends exploring a theme park called "Welcome Land." But behind this seemingly happy place, lie hidden truths in the smile of an android.
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: Sacred Eye of the Void: Goodbye Vincent
title.it: L`occhio sacro nel cielo - Goodbye, Vincent
title.pt-BR: O olho flutuante que tudo vê - Adeus, Vincent

20.overview: Vincent finds himself trapped within Re-l's consciousness, and observes powerlessly as events unfold.
20.summary:
A pulse that beats out a rhythm like clockwork. A figure that wakes up in a hospital room and slowly raises his body. Who is this figure?
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: Planet at the End of Time: Shampoo Planet
title.it: Dove il tempo e esaurito - shampoo planet
title.pt-BR: O lugar que o tempo esqueceu - Planeta Shampoo
title.x-jat: Toki Hate Tsuru Sho: Shampoo Planet

21.overview: A Cogito outbreak spreads through Romdo and the city falls into chaos. Vincent incites the people to revolt, pushing them to hunt down and kill all AutoReivs.
21.summary:
Vince suddenly disappears. Re-l and Pino desperately search all over the city in order to find him. Awakening.
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Laços - Bilbul

22.overview: As the city continues to crumble, Vincent and Re-l encounter Proxy One. Raul is overcome with regret and despair, and sets out to find Pino.
22.summary:
A sudden incident that falls upon Re-l and Pino. And the frequent appearances of Proxy. What could his true identity be?
Source: crunchyroll

title.pt-BR: Proxy - Deus surgido da máquina

23.overview: Pieces are played and revelations uncovered as the final fight commences. Monad makes her return and tries to convince Vincent to join her.
23.summary:
The closed paradise Romdo`s mysterious veil that covers the world is finally stripped off. What will become of Vince, Re-l and Pino.
Source: crunchyroll
